test_results.observation: GET hit recorded one Redis success with no fallback; GET miss recorded one Redis success and one miss fallback while returning the MongoDB fixture.
GET Redis error recorded one error outcome and one redis_error fallback for both MongoDB success and MongoDB failure; Redis classification stayed stable.
SET_EX success and error were each recorded once; a SET_EX error did not change the MongoDB-derived business result or miss fallback reason.
The existing common-groups cache path recorded SET success and error once while preserving the MongoDB-derived result.
DEL success and error were each recorded once; invalidation remained non-throwing and emitted no fallback decision.
Each logical cache-aside call emitted exactly one GET, one fallback decision, and one SET_EX; independent calls remained independently counted.
Metrics adapter observation failures did not change the cache business result; warning evidence remained bounded and sanitized.
Prometheus exposition contained only the approved Redis/fallback metric families, labels, and allowlist values; unsupported values were dropped.
